correctness.rationale: Stars-and-bars gives B_r(n) total weak compositions and H_r(n) marked equal pairs. Exactly two edges touch a marked vacancy, giving 2 B_{r-2}; each of the other r-2 edges gives H_{r-1}. Subtracting the product of means yields formula (1). Explicit parity-separated sums for H_2,H_3,H_4,H_5 produce each of the six rational covariances. Strict signs follow from numerator factors, including boundary totals 0 and 1. The packaged verifier passed 3060 exact rational checks, including independent exhaustive enumerations, but finite enumeration is only corroboration of the symbolic proof.

value.rationale: Vacancy frequency versus neighboring count agreement is a natural dependence diagnostic for cyclical exchangeable Pólya count data. The exact parity orthogonality at three and four categories, opposing nonzero signs, and disappearance of parity zeros for the first five-category case identify a motivated minimal-category boundary for all totals rather than one arbitrary numerical slice. The formula supplies finite-sample null calibration. The result does not extrapolate a sign theorem to larger categories.
